description.zh:
給定奇數整數 \( n \)，產生一個大小為 \( \left ( n \times n \right ) \) 的二維陣列。用“.”的單一字串填入每個元素。 。然後用單一字串“*”（雪花的圖片）填滿中間行、中間列和對角線。列印 \( \left ( n \times n \right ) \) 行和列中的陣列元素，並以單一空格分隔字元。

C++ 注意： 對於二維數組，請使用 vector>。第一個索引是行，第二個索引是列。
description.en:
Given an odd number integer \( n \), produce a two-dimensional array of size \( \left ( n \times n \right ) \). Fill each element with a single character string of "." . Then fill the middle row, the middle column and the diagnals with the single character string of "*" (an image of a snow flake). Print the array elements in \( \left ( n \times n \right ) \) rows and columns and separate the characters with a single space.

C++ note: Use vector<vector<int>> for a two-dimensional array. The first index is the row and the second is the column.

hint.zh: Python 二維 list 在此章對應 vector<vector<int>>；第一個索引是列，第二個索引是欄。
hint.en: Use vector<vector<int>> for a two-dimensional array. The first index is the row and the second is the column.
